entities.summary: Diamond Louis Stone is an American professional basketball player for the Marinos de Anzoátegui of the Superliga Profesional de Baloncesto (SPB). He played one season of college basketball for the Maryland Terrapins before being drafted 40th overall in the 2016 NBA draft by the New Orleans Pelicans.
